Interface IUDFValueResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
WikipediaUDFValueResolver
public interface IUDFValueResolver
A built-in lookup of the fill source RESOLVER against an external, keyed source. The fill rule of such a field is <resolverId> optionally followed by a space and an argument, for example WIKIPEDIA de,en. Implementations are Spring beans; every request to a public source goes through UDFFillHttp.

      ResolveOutcome resolve(Security security, String argument)
      Looks up the value for a security. Must be called outside any transaction; may make HTTP requests.
